field_semantics.id: Canonical concept id. AGROVOC c_NNNNN ids are stable.
field_semantics.display: The ONLY string that may be shown to a user.
field_semantics.match: Alternate names that MUST match a user query and MUST NEVER be displayed. Includes colloquialisms, regionalisms, plurals, source-organism names and scientific names.
field_semantics.sources: Which upstream records justified this concept's terms.

curated_terms_applied_offline.reason: the ordinary Russian word for butter; AGROVOC has only the qualified `сливочное масло`, and the lemma fold sent the bare word to the oils concept c_5334 instead. Verified 2026-08-02 against GeneratedCatalog.kt: fan-out 0, no record carried it.

the American spelling; AGROVOC's entire en entry for this concept is the British spelling `yoghurt` as a bare display with no match list, so `yogurt` is not anywhere in the source data. Without it, and paired with generate-catalog-kotlin.py's RESTATES_HEAD_EXCEPTIONS carve-out (the term would otherwise be dropped as restating its own head `Yogurt`), the coverage formula sent `yogert`/`yogurt` to the unrelated `Tofu yogurt` record instead of any real yogurt. Verified 2026-08-03 against GeneratedCatalog.kt: fan-out 0, no record carried the American spelling.
